description: This file defines the OpenAIImageGenerationHandler class, which manages the application of guardrails to OpenAI's image generation requests and responses within a larger system for handling LLM interactions. It processes input prompts to enforce guardrails and provides a stub for post-response processing, primarily for logging or extension.

classes.name: OpenAIImageGenerationHandler
classes.description: A handler class for managing guardrail application during OpenAI image generation requests and responses.
